title: Nurse says the Wright Patterson craft came from Aztec

tellings.quote: That's how they found out it came from Aztec. She claimed it came from Aztec

plain: A craft held at Wright Patterson, the Air Force base in Dayton, Ohio, came from a reported UFO crash near Aztec, New Mexico, according to a nurse. Scott Ramsey, a researcher who has investigated the Aztec case, passes on her claim to Michels: "She claimed it came from Aztec." If true, it would link the Aztec crash to the wreckage kept at the base.
